_comment: Segment library for timer-driven audio. Keys map to audio/<voice>/seg/<key>.mp3. Numbers n1..n20 + n0; shared cues under cue/; per-drill setup lines under drill/<slug>/setup.
drill/stick_07/setup: The triangle! Get set, puck in front, stay low. Move it point to point to point.
drill/stick_01/setup: Base and technique! Get low, hands soft, puck out front. Slide it side to side, quick and smooth.
drill/stick_02/setup: Front to back time! Stay low, puck in front. Push it out, pull it back to your toes.
drill/stick_03/setup: Here we go! Get set, low and loose. Push forward, drag it back, then shove it wide.
drill/stick_04/setup: Wide extensions! Set your stance, reach as far as you can, forehand and backhand.
drill/stick_05/setup: Narrow to wide! Get low, three tiny touches, then blast the puck out wide.
drill/stick_06/setup: Figure eight! Two cones set, low and ready. Guide that puck around and keep it flowing.
drill/stick_08/setup: The diamond matrix! Four cones, low stance, ready. Weave that puck around every point.
drill/stick_09/setup: Z-pattern slalom! Stay low, puck out front. Zig it forward left, then forward right.
drill/stick_10/setup: The square box! Get set, hands soft. Trace it front, side, back, side.
drill/stick_11/setup: Top hand only! Just your top hand on the stick. Get low, stay in control.
drill/stick_12/setup: Bottom hand only! Grip it down low, one hand. Get set and keep that puck close.
drill/stick_13/setup: Toe drag and rescue! Stay low, puck wide. Hook it back with the toe of your blade.
drill/stick_14/setup: Heel to toe flips! Get set, puck on your blade. Roll it heel to toe and pop it up.
drill/stick_15/setup: Flip over objects! Set your barrier, get low. Chip that puck right up and over.
drill/stick_16/setup: Eyes up glancing! Puck out front, chin up. Stickhandle and keep your eyes on the target.
drill/stick_17/setup: The wall bounce! Face the wall, hands ready. Pass it, then catch that rebound soft.
drill/stick_18/setup: Cone weave course! Five cones lined up, low and loose. Weave that puck all the way through.
drill/stick_19/setup: Chaos dribbling! Scatter your stuff, get set. Weave through it and keep your head up.
drill/shoot_01/setup: Moving warm-up! Face the net, feet going. Get comfy shooting without stopping.
drill/shoot_02/setup: Change the angle! Feet moving, net in sight. Pull the puck over and fire from the new spot.
drill/shoot_03/setup: Random target! Feet moving before you even pick a spot. Face that net and rip it.
drill/shoot_04/setup: Under two seconds! Feet going, puck ready. Get it off your stick fast, no overthinking.
drill/shoot_05/setup: Ten different goals! Feet moving, net set. Change up your release every single shot.
drill/shoot_06/setup: Backhand basics! Face the net, feet ready. Load it on your backhand and release clean.
drill/shoot_07/setup: Backhand accuracy! Net in sight, feet moving. Pick your spots and hit them on purpose.
drill/shoot_08/setup: Moving backhand! Keep those feet going. Fire a backhand while you are still on the move.
drill/shoot_09/setup: Forehand to backhand! Feet moving, net ready. Show forehand first, then switch and shoot.
drill/shoot_10/setup: Backhand only! Face the net, feet going. The only way to score is on your backhand.
drill/shoot_11/setup: Quick hands! Get in tight to the net, feet moving. Control it close and finish.
drill/shoot_12/setup: Catch and release! Feet ready near the net. Grab that pass and shoot before the goalie resets.
drill/shoot_13/setup: Pull across! Feet moving, net in sight. Drag it across your body, then finish from the new angle.
drill/shoot_14/setup: Forehand backhand finish! Feet going to the net. Decide your side at the last second and shoot.
drill/shoot_15/setup: Rebound finish! Feet moving, stay near the net. Fire your shot, then bury the rebound.
drill/shoot_16/setup: Carry, pass, shoot! Feet going, net ready. Link the carry, the pass, and the shot into one play.
drill/shoot_17/setup: Bad puck challenge! Feet moving, net set. Get set to shoot pucks that come in ugly.
drill/shoot_18/setup: Angle attack! Feet moving toward the cone. Cut around it and shoot from the new lane.
drill/shoot_19/setup: Quick release challenge! Feet ready near the net. See how fast you turn a pass into a shot.
drill/dry_01/setup: Will's squares! Get set on your toes, head up. Quick light hops through the square.
drill/dry_02/setup: Skater jumps! Load up on one leg. Jump sideways and stick that landing.
drill/dry_03/setup: Broad jumps! Feet set, arms back, get ready. Jump forward far and land soft.
drill/dry_04/setup: Box jumps! Face your box, knees bent. Spring up and land nice and quiet.
drill/dry_05/setup: Reverse lunges! Stand tall, hands ready. Step back, drop down, and drive right up.
drill/dry_06/setup: Single leg RDL! Balance on one leg, arms out. Tip forward slow like a seesaw.
drill/dry_07/setup: Wall sit! Back on the wall, slide down to a chair shape. Hold strong and breathe.
drill/dry_08/setup: Sit-ups! Lie back, knees bent, hands ready. Curl up with your belly, not your neck.
drill/dry_09/setup: Plank shoulder taps! Get into a strong plank, body flat. Hold it steady and breathe.
drill/dry_10/setup: Stair sprints! Face the stairs, feet ready. Run up fast and walk back down slow.
drill/dry_11/setup: Sprint starts! Get set in your ready stance. Explode into those first steps as fast as you can.
drill/dry_12/setup: Reaction start! Eyes on your partner, feet ready. Catch that ball before the second bounce.
drill/dry_13/setup: Split squat hold! Drop into a deep lunge, chest tall. Hold strong and breathe.
drill/dry_14/setup: Calf raises! Stand tall, feet set. Push up high on your toes and come down slow.
drill/dry_15/setup: Dead bugs! Lie on your back, arms and legs up. Lower opposite arm and leg, slow and smooth.
drill/dry_16/setup: McDavid's! Feet moving, hands working. Get set, eyes up, and call the numbers.
